tasks.subject: Task 1: config repositories optional
tasks.description:
**Goal:** a config file may omit `repositories`; when present it validates exactly as before.

**Verify:** uv run pytest tests/test_config.py -q && just check-types

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ghr_pypi/config.py", "tests/test_config.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_config.py -q && just check-types", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Config.repositories defaults to ()", "config with only title loads", "repositories: [] still rejected", "malformed entry and duplicates still rejected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: _resolve_config, variadic REPO, --out default
tasks.description:
**Goal:** zero-argument invocation resolves from $GITHUB_REPOSITORY and writes to _site; precedence unit-testable without CliRunner.

**Verify:** just test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ghr_pypi/cli.py", "src/ghr_pypi/config.py", "tests/conftest.py", "tests/test_cli.py"], "verifyCommand": "just test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["autouse fixture deletes GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "_resolve_config pure, raises ConfigError", "precedence config > args > env", "args+config error, env+config fine", "url derived from env in both branches", "title derived only without config", "--out defaults to _site", "mutation-proven wiring"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: workflow, docs, full gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** pages.yml uses the zero-argument form; every doc describing the old contract is corrected.

**Verify:** just check-all

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/pages.yml", "README.md", "direction.md", "doc/source/reference/cli.rst", "doc/source/reference/configuration.rst", "doc/source/how-to/build-failed.rst", "doc/source/tutorials/github-pages.rst", "doc/source/changelog.rst"], "verifyCommand": "just check-all", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pages.yml runs bare CLI, no with: path:", "no 'exactly one of REPO' anywhere", "cli.rst documents variadic REPO, env fallback, _site", "configuration.rst shows repositories optional", "build-failed.rst lists the new messages", "direction.md bullets removed", "just check-all exit 0"]}
```
